definition_zh: 牢靠的；安心的；获得；使牢固
definition_en: fixed or fastened so that it cannot be lost or opened easily; free from worry; to get or make firm
core_image: 一把扣紧的锁，门被牢牢固定，里面的人不再担心
scene: 银行新装的门锁经过测试，工作人员确认一切稳妥。The new vault door is secure, so nobody can break in at night.
sceneCN: 这里 secure 是「牢固的、锁紧的」（第 1 个义项：固定不动、不易被打开）；句意是新金库门很牢固，夜里没人能闯进来。

derivatives.zh: 由 secure 加 -ity 名词后缀构成，义为「安全；保障」
secure 加 -ly 副词后缀，义为「牢固地；安心地」
加否定前缀 in-，义为「不安全的；不自信的」

senses.title: Fastened or locked firmly
senses.definition: made firm so that it cannot move, fall, or be opened easily
senses.definitionCN: 固定得很紧，不会移动、掉落或轻易被打开
senses.example: Make sure the rope is secure before you climb.
senses.exampleCN: 爬之前要确认绳子已经系牢。
senses.why: The core image is a locked door: something has been physically fastened so it stays in place.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是扣紧的门：某物被固定住，稳稳待在原位。

senses.title: Free from danger or worry
senses.definition: safe from harm, and not worried about losing something
senses.definitionCN: 不受伤害的威胁，也不担心失去什么
senses.example: With a steady income she finally felt secure.
senses.exampleCN: 有了稳定收入，她终于感到安心。
senses.why: When the door is locked, the person inside stops worrying — physical firmness becomes emotional safety.
senses.whyCN: 门锁好了，里面的人不再担心——物理上的牢固引申为内心的安稳。

senses.title: To obtain something after effort
senses.definition: to get something that you want, especially after trying hard
senses.definitionCN: 经过努力得到想要的东西，尤指来之不易之物
senses.example: She secured a scholarship after months of practice.
senses.exampleCN: 经过几个月练习，她拿到了奖学金。
senses.why: Locking something in means you finally hold it — gaining it and keeping it at once.
senses.whyCN: 「锁住」意味着你终于握住了它——得到并留住。

senses.title: To fasten or hold firmly
senses.definition: to attach or fix something firmly in place
senses.definitionCN: 把某物牢牢固定或连接在某个位置
senses.example: The crew secured the cargo before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 船员在风暴来临前把货物固定好。
senses.why: The same image of the locked door works as an action: you are the one who fastens it.
senses.whyCN: 还是那扇扣紧的门，这次变成动作：由你来把它固定住。

senses.title: Protected from loss or risk
senses.definition: protected so that money, information, or rights cannot be taken away
senses.definitionCN: 受到保护，钱财、信息或权利不会被夺走
senses.example: Please keep your documents in a secure place.
senses.exampleCN: 请把文件放在有保障的地方。
senses.why: A locked vault protects what is inside, so the word extends to anything guarded.
senses.whyCN: 上了锁的保险库保护里面的东西，这个词便延伸到一切被守护的对象。

intro.en: From Latin securus, meaning free from care, built on se- (free from) and cura (care).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 securus，意为「无忧虑的」，由 se-（免除）与 cura（操心）构成。

items.en: The root *kweye- means to pay attention or care; it also gives Latin cura.
items.cn: 重构词根 *kweye- 表示「留意、操心」，也派生出拉丁语 cura。

items.en: Securus combines se- (apart, free from) with cura (care), so it literally means free from care.
items.cn: 拉丁语 securus 由 se-（脱离）加 cura（操心）构成，字面义是「免于操心」。

items.en: The word passed into Old French as seur, meaning safe and certain.
items.cn: 该词进入古法语作 seur，意为「安全的、确定的」。

items.en: Middle French forms such as seur and secure influenced English borrowing.
items.cn: 中世纪法语形式 seur、secure 影响了英语的借用。

items.en: English took secure in the 1500s, first meaning free from fear, then fixed firmly.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 secure，先表「不再恐惧」，后表「固定牢靠」。

items.en: Today it covers firm attachment, safety, confidence, and obtaining something.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖牢固、安全、安心以及获得等含义。

note.en: Words that look or sound like secure, and near-meaning rivals in the field of safety.
note.cn: 与 secure 拼写相近的词，以及安全义场中的近义对手。

entries.definition: to keep someone apart from other people
entries.definitionCN: 使隔绝；使隐退——拼写与 secure 相近，但词义完全不同，无同源关系

entries.definition: eager to know or learn something
entries.definitionCN: 好奇的——与 secure 共享拉丁 cura 的远源联想易混淆，词形并不相同，注意区分
确定的——与 secure 同源于拉丁 securus 经法语的简化形式

entries.definition: out of danger and not harmed
entries.definitionCN: 安全的——强调处境无危险，secure 更强调固定与保障

entries.definition: to close or fix something firmly
entries.definitionCN: 系紧；固定——与 secure 的动词义相近，但不含获得义
取得——与 secure 的「获得」义项近义，但 secure 更强调保住成果

normalIntro.en: Memory hooks built on the real root cura (care) and the locked-door image.
normalIntro.cn: 基于真实词根 cura（操心）与锁门画面的记忆钩子。

normal.en: se- means free from + cura means care, so secure is free from care
normal.cn: se- 表示「免除」+ cura 表示「操心」，secure 字面就是「免于操心」

normal.en: sure and secure share the same Old French ancestor
normal.cn: sure 与 secure 同出一脉，都来自古法语

normal.en: the locked vault is the core picture of the adjective
normal.cn: 上了锁的金库就是形容词义的核心画面

normal.en: secure a job = lock the job in so you cannot lose it
normal.cn: secure a job 就是把工作「锁进保险柜」，不会丢

normal.en: in- reverses it: insecure means not safe and not confident
normal.cn: 加上 in- 就反转：insecure 既不安全也不自信

abstract.en: Picture clicking a padlock shut and feeling your shoulders relax
abstract.cn: 想象咔哒一声扣上挂锁，肩膀随之放松的画面

abstract.en: See a rope tied with a double knot that nothing can shake
abstract.cn: 看见一根绳打了双结，怎么晃都不会松

abstract.en: Feel the moment your offer letter arrives and the worry drains away
abstract.cn: 体会录取通知到达那一刻，担忧一扫而空的感受

examples.en: The engineer secured the ladder before painting the wall.
examples.cn: 油漆工先把梯子固定好再刷墙。

examples.en: She finally secured a contract with the city government.
examples.cn: 她终于和市政府签下了合同。

examples.en: A secure network keeps hackers out of the system.
examples.cn: 安全的网络把黑客挡在系统之外。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「色库了」——东西锁进色库（仓库）里了，牢牢的，谁也拿不走，所以又牢固又安心。

root: 拉丁语 se-（免除）+ cura（操心、照料，与 curious 同出一源）构成 securus「免于操心的」；经古法语 seur 进入英语。secure 的「固定」「安心」「获得」三义都从「锁住无忧」生长出来。

sensesIntro.en: From the locked vault picture, the word fans out into firmness, safety, and gain.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「上锁的金库」这一画面出发，词义展开为牢固、安全与获得。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a locked vault — firmly shut and worry-free
core.cn: 核心意象：上了锁的金库——关得牢牢的，不再操心

branches.en: firm attachment and the act of fixing things down
branches.cn: 物理上的系紧与固定动作

branches.en: inner calm once danger is out of reach
branches.cn: 危险被挡在外面后的内心安稳

branches.en: winning and keeping something valuable
branches.cn: 赢得并守住有价值的东西

branches.en: the door stays shut and the mind stays quiet
branches.cn: 门关得住，心也静得下来

branches.en: you are the one turning the key
branches.cn: 你正是转钥匙的那个人

intro.en: English words built around the Latin pair se- (free from) and cura (care).
intro.cn: 围绕拉丁语 se-（免除）与 cura（操心）构成的英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives that share the cura root.
latinIntro.cn: 共享 cura 词根的拉丁同族词。

items.example: The suspect was sequestered from the jury.
items.exampleCN: 陪审团被隔离，与外界分开。

items.example: Curation means taking care of a collection.
items.exampleCN: 「策展」就是悉心照料一批藏品。

items.example: Secure the window before the typhoon.
items.exampleCN: 台风来之前把窗户固定好。

items.example: I am sure he locked the door.
He felt insecure about his new role.

items.exampleCN: 机场安检检查每一件行李。

items.meaning: to take care of and select content
items.example: She curates the gallery each spring.
items.exampleCN: 她每年春天为画廊策展。

items.meaningCN: 模糊的；晦涩的——与 secure 形近但词源不同，来自拉丁 ob- 加基词 cuvere
items.example: The meaning of the poem remains obscure.
items.exampleCN: 这首诗的含义仍不明朗。

definition_zh: 安全；保障措施；保安；证券
definition_en: the state of being safe from harm; measures that protect people or property; a financial document that proves ownership
core_image: 门口站岗的保安与上锁的保险库，一切都被守护着
scene: 演唱会前场馆加强了人员检查，观众都感到踏实。The airport raised its security before the holiday rush.
sceneCN: 这里 security 是「安保措施」（第 2 个义项：为防危险而采取的行动）；句意是机场在假期高峰前提升了安保级别。

derivatives.zh: security 的动词与形容词同根形式，义为「使安全；牢固的」
加 -ize 动词后缀，义为「把资产证券化」
加否定前缀 in-，义为「不安全感」

senses.title: The state of being safe
senses.definition: the condition of not being in danger or of not being attacked
senses.definitionCN: 没有危险、不被攻击的处境
senses.example: The treaty promised security for both nations.
senses.exampleCN: 条约承诺保障两国的安全。
senses.why: The locked vault means nothing inside gets hurt — the calm state after protection.
senses.whyCN: 上锁的金库意味着里面的东西毫发无损——被保护后的安稳状态。

senses.title: Measures that protect people or things
senses.definition: actions and systems designed to prevent crime, attack, or loss
senses.definitionCN: 为防犯罪、袭击或损失而设计的行动与制度
senses.example: Show your passport at the security check.
senses.exampleCN: 在安检处出示护照。
senses.why: The guards, locks and cameras are the active version of the locked door.
senses.whyCN: 保安、门锁与摄像头就是「那扇锁着的门」的动态版本。

senses.title: People who guard a place
senses.definition: people employed to watch over a building or event
senses.definitionCN: 受雇看守建筑或活动的人员
senses.example: Security stopped him at the entrance.
senses.exampleCN: 保安在入口处拦住了他。
senses.why: The protectors themselves take the name of what they provide.
senses.whyCN: 守护者以他们所提供的东西为名。

senses.title: Money or property pledged for a loan
senses.definition: assets promised to a lender in case the debt is not repaid
senses.definitionCN: 为贷款提供的资产，若不还债即被收走
senses.example: He offered his house as security for the loan.
senses.exampleCN: 他拿房子为贷款作抵押。
senses.why: What is locked in the vault can be claimed if promises break.
senses.whyCN: 金库里锁着的东西，一旦承诺落空便可被取走。

senses.title: Financial instruments that prove ownership
senses.definition: documents such as stocks and bonds that show investment or debt
senses.definitionCN: 股票、债券等表明投资或债权关系的凭证
senses.example: Government securities are considered very safe investments.
senses.exampleCN: 政府证券被视为非常安全的投资。
senses.why: A pledged promise in writing becomes a tradable object — safety turned into paper.
senses.whyCN: 被抵押的书面承诺变成可交易的对象——安全感被写成了纸。

intro.en: From Latin securitas, the noun form of securus (free from care).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 securitas，即 securus（无忧的）的名词形式。

items.en: The root behind Latin cura again means to care or pay attention.
items.cn: 与拉丁语 cura 同源的重构词根，仍表「留意、操心」。

items.en: Securitas means freedom from care and danger, formed from securus with the noun ending -tas.
items.cn: 拉丁语 securitas 由 securus 加名词后缀 -tas 构成，意为「无忧无险」。

items.en: Old French seurte carried the meaning of safety and certainty.
items.cn: 古法语 seurte 承载了安全与确定之义。

items.en: Forms like seurete reached England through law and commerce.
items.cn: seurete 等形式经法律与商业渠道传入英格兰。

items.en: English security first meant freedom from care, then protection and legal pledge.
items.cn: 英语 security 先表「无忧」，后发展出保护与法律担保义。

items.en: Modern use spans safety, guarding services, collateral, and financial securities.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖安全、安保服务、抵押品与金融证券。

note.en: Look-alikes around the -urity spelling, and nearby words in the protection field.
note.cn: -urity 拼写附近的形近词，以及保护义场的近义词。

entries.definition: the desire to learn or know
entries.definitionCN: 好奇心——与 security 拼写相近且同含 cura 词源，但语义相反方向：一个向外探，一个向内守

entries.definition: the state of being unknown or unclear
entries.definitionCN: 晦涩；无名——拼写与 security 相近，但词根不同，注意区分

entries.definition: a person or thing that guarantees a promise
entries.definitionCN: 保证人；担保——与 security 的抵押义项直接同源

entries.definition: the condition of being safe from harm
entries.definitionCN: 安全——泛指无危险，security 更强调主动的防护体系

entries.definition: the act of keeping someone or something safe
entries.definitionCN: 保护——强调动作，security 既指状态也指制度

entries.definition: a formal promise that something will happen
entries.definitionCN: 担保——与抵押义项相近，但 guarantee 偏承诺，security 偏实物

normalIntro.en: Hooks anchored in the -ity noun ending and the guard-at-the-door picture.
normalIntro.cn: 锚定在 -ity 名词后缀与门口保安画面上的记忆钩子。

normal.en: secure + -ity: the noun form of secure
normal.cn: secure 加 -ity 就是它的名词形式

normal.en: curiosity and security share the cura root but pull opposite ways
normal.cn: curiosity 与 security 同源却方向相反：一个好奇外探，一个守成

normal.en: the airport guard is the human face of this word
normal.cn: 机场保安就是这个词的人格化形象

normal.en: securities in finance are assets locked in as guarantees
normal.cn: 金融里的 securities 是被锁进来作担保的资产

normal.en: in- flips it: insecurity is the feeling of no protection
normal.cn: 加 in- 就反转：insecurity 是失去保护的感觉

abstract.en: Picture a guard with a clipboard standing at every door
abstract.cn: 想象每个门口都站着拿登记板的保安

abstract.en: See camera lights blinking quietly over a sleeping city
abstract.cn: 看见摄像头在沉睡的城市上空静静闪烁

abstract.en: Feel the weight of the key chain in the night watchman's pocket
abstract.cn: 体会守夜人口袋里钥匙串沉甸甸的分量

examples.en: Tight security kept the ceremony running smoothly.
examples.cn: 严密的安保让典礼顺利进行。

examples.en: She sold her securities to fund the new clinic.
examples.cn: 她卖掉证券为新诊所筹资。

examples.en: A steady job gave him a sense of security.
examples.cn: 稳定的工作给了他安全感。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「色库里提」——从色库（仓库）里提东西？不行，得先过保安这一关，安保与证券的意思全在里面。

root: 拉丁语 securus（无忧的）+ 名词后缀 -tas 构成 securitas「无忧无险的状态」；经古法语 seurte 进入英语。抵押与证券义由「被锁住作担保的财产」引申而来。

sensesIntro.en: One picture, four uses: the calm state, the guarding system, the pledged asset, the paper claim.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个画面，四种用法：安稳状态、守护体系、抵押资产与纸面凭证。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a guard at the vault door, everything watched and safe
core.cn: 核心意象：金库门口的保安，一切被看守、被守护

branches.en: the quiet that comes when danger is kept out
branches.cn: 危险被挡在外面后的安宁

branches.en: the guards, cameras and checks that make the calm
branches.cn: 保安、摄像头与安检共同造就这份安宁

branches.en: the vault contents promised to a lender
branches.cn: 金库里的东西被许诺给债主

branches.en: the promise turned into tradable paper
branches.cn: 承诺变成了可交易的纸

branches.en: protection and peace are two sides of one door
branches.cn: 保护与安宁是同一扇门的两面

intro.en: Nouns and verbs built from the secure family and the -ity ending.
intro.cn: 由 secure 词族与 -ity 后缀构成的名词与动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin nouns in the cura family.
latinIntro.cn: cura 词族里的拉丁名词。

items.example: Purity means the state of being pure.
items.exampleCN: purity 表示「纯净」这一状态。

items.example: Securitas was also a Roman goddess.
items.exampleCN: Securitas 还是罗马的安全女神。

items.example: Security was tight at the summit.
He acted as surety for his brother.

items.exampleCN: 好奇心驱动每位科学家。

items.example: His insecurity showed in his silence.

items.meaningCN: 无名；晦涩——形近但词源不同，来自 obscurus（黑暗的）
items.example: The poet lived in obscurity for years.
items.exampleCN: 这位诗人默默无闻多年。

definition_zh: 看见；明白；会见；查看
definition_en: to notice people or things with your eyes; to understand; to meet or visit someone
core_image: 睁开的眼睛把光收进来，画面直达心里
scene: 推开窗帘，阳光一下子涌了进来。I see the mountains clearly from my window every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 see 是「看见」（第 1 个义项：用眼睛注意到）；句意是我每天清晨都能从窗口清楚望见群山。

derivatives.zh: see 的古英语同根名词形式，义为「视力；景象」
see 的动名词形式，义为「观看；视觉」
see 加 -er，义为「能看见的人；先知」

senses.title: To notice with your eyes
senses.definition: to become aware of someone or something by using your eyes
senses.definitionCN: 用眼睛察觉到人或事物
senses.example: She saw a rainbow after the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 雨后她看见了一道彩虹。
senses.why: The opened eye receives light — the most direct physical act of knowing.
senses.whyCN: 睁开的眼睛接收光线——这是最直接的感知动作。

senses.title: To understand something
senses.definition: to understand an idea, a joke, or a situation
senses.definitionCN: 理解一个观点、玩笑或处境
senses.example: I see why you are upset now.
senses.exampleCN: 我现在明白你为何难过了。
senses.why: What the eye grasps at once, the mind grasps too — seeing becomes knowing.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛一眼抓住的东西，头脑也能抓住——「看」引申为「懂」。

senses.title: To meet or visit someone
senses.definition: to go to a place to meet or talk with someone
senses.definitionCN: 到某地与某人见面或交谈
senses.example: The manager will see you at three.
senses.exampleCN: 经理三点见你。
senses.why: Seeing someone face to face is another way the eye-word grows: meeting is looking at each other.
senses.whyCN: 面对面「看见」彼此——会面义由此生长。

senses.title: To consult or check something
senses.definition: to find information by looking at a source or place
senses.definitionCN: 通过看资料或地点获取信息
senses.example: Check the map and see which road is shorter.
senses.exampleCN: 查查地图，看哪条路更近。
senses.why: You aim your eyes at the answer — the look becomes a search.
senses.whyCN: 把目光投向答案——这一「看」变成了一次搜寻。

senses.title: To imagine or foresee
senses.definition: to picture something in your mind or predict it
senses.definitionCN: 在头脑中构想或预测某事
senses.example: I can see a bright future for this team.
senses.exampleCN: 我预见到这个团队的光明前景。
senses.why: The inner eye can look forward as well as outward.
senses.whyCN: 心灵的眼睛既能向外观，也能向前看。

intro.en: From Old English seon, one of the most ancient verbs in the language.
intro.cn: 来自古英语 seon，是英语中最古老的动词之一。

items.en: The reconstructed root *sekH- relates to following and observing.
items.cn: 重构词根 *sekH- 与「跟随、观察」相关。

items.en: The root became Germanic forms meaning to see, seen across many Germanic languages.
items.cn: 该词根发展出日耳曼语族各语言中表「看」的形式。

items.en: Old English seon meant to see, look, or behold.

items.en: The form settled into seen and see in Middle English spelling.
items.cn: 中古英语拼写作 seen、see，词形趋于稳定。

items.en: Modern see keeps all five core uses, from eyesight to understanding.
items.cn: 现代 see 保留了从视力到理解的核心用法。

note.en: Look-alikes with the same vowel shape, and near rivals in the field of perception.

entries.definition: to look at something for a period of time
entries.definitionCN: 观看——强调持续注视，see 只强调「注意到」
观察——正式用词，含留心记录之意

entries.definition: to know the meaning of something
entries.definitionCN: 理解——与 see 的「明白」义项对应

normalIntro.en: Hooks built on the eye and the homophone sea.
normalIntro.cn: 基于眼睛画面与同音词 sea 的记忆钩子。

normal.en: see → saw → seen: the shortest irregular verb chain in English
normal.cn: see → saw → seen：英语最短的不规则动词链之一

normal.en: sea and see sound the same but the sea has no eyes
normal.cn: sea 与 see 同音，但大海没有眼睛

normal.en: I see what you mean = the eye of the mind opened
normal.cn: I see what you mean = 心灵之眼睁开了

normal.en: see a doctor uses meeting sense, not eyesight
normal.cn: see a doctor 用的是「会面」义，不是视力

normal.en: let me see buys thinking time in conversation
normal.cn: let me see 在对话中用来争取思考时间

abstract.en: Picture light pouring through an open window into your mind
abstract.cn: 想象光从敞开的窗口涌入脑海

abstract.en: See a light bulb switch on above a nodding head
abstract.cn: 看见点头的人头顶亮起灯泡

abstract.en: Feel the moment a puzzle finally makes sense
abstract.cn: 体会谜题豁然开朗的那一刻

examples.en: I saw an old friend at the market yesterday.
examples.cn: 昨天我在集市上遇见一位老友。

examples.en: She saw the point of the plan at once.
examples.cn: 她立刻看懂了方案的要点。

examples.en: Please see the notice board for details.
examples.cn: 详情请查看公告栏。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「嘻嘻」——看见好笑的事就嘻嘻笑，眼睛和笑声一起工作。

root: 古英语 seon「看见」，源自日耳曼语族共同词根，最终可追溯至重构的印欧词根 *sekH-（跟随、观察）。是英语核心动词中词源最清楚、历史最连续的一个。

sensesIntro.en: One verb, five ways of knowing: the eye, the mind, the meeting, the search, the foresight.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个动词，五种认知：眼睛、头脑、会面、搜寻与预见。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open eye taking in light
core.cn: 核心意象：一只睁开的眼睛接收光线

branches.en: light enters and something is noticed
branches.cn: 光进入，某物被注意到

branches.en: the mind sees what the eye sees
branches.cn: 心看到眼所看到的

branches.en: facing each other across a table
branches.cn: 隔着桌子彼此相望

branches.en: the gaze turns into a hunt for facts
branches.cn: 目光变成对事实的搜寻

branches.en: the inner eye looks ahead in time
branches.cn: 心灵的眼睛望向未来

We saw the film last night.
items.exampleCN: 我们昨晚看了那部电影。

items.example: The show has been seen by millions.

items.example: The sunset is a beautiful sight.

items.meaning: the power to see inside a problem

items.meaningCN: 似乎——形近但源自古诺斯语，词根不同

definition_zh: 种子；起源；选手排名；播种
definition_en: a small object from which a plant grows; the cause or beginning of something; to rank players in a tournament
core_image: 一粒小种子埋进土里，悄悄决定未来整株植物的模样
scene: 春天到了，农妇蹲在田里准备下种。Every seed in this packet will grow into a sunflower.
sceneCN: 这里 seed 是「种子」（第 1 个义项：能长成植物的颗粒）；句意是这包里的每粒种子都会长成向日葵。

derivatives.zh: seed 加 -y 形容词后缀，义为「结籽的；破旧的；可疑的」
seed 加 -ling 名词后缀，义为「幼苗」
seed 的过去分词形容词用法，义为「已播种的；（选手）列为种子的」

senses.title: A grain that grows into a plant
senses.definition: a small hard part of a plant that can grow into a new plant
senses.definitionCN: 植物体内能长出新植株的小颗粒
senses.example: She saved seeds from the best tomatoes.
senses.exampleCN: 她把最好的番茄留了种。
senses.why: The tiny buried kernel silently holds the whole future plant.
senses.whyCN: 埋进土里的小颗粒悄悄装着未来整株植物。

senses.title: The beginning or hidden cause of something
senses.definition: the start or hidden cause of a feeling, idea, or event
senses.definitionCN: 情感、想法或事件的起点或隐藏诱因
senses.example: The defeat planted the seed of reform.
senses.exampleCN: 这场失败埋下了改革的种子。
senses.why: What fits in a grain can later fill a field — causes start small.
senses.whyCN: 一粒之内的东西日后能占满一整片田——起因总是从微小开始。

senses.title: A ranked player in a tournament
senses.definition: a player given a ranking so strong rivals do not meet early
senses.definitionCN: 在赛事中被排定名次、避免强者过早相遇的选手
senses.example: The top seed won every round easily.
senses.exampleCN: 头号种子轻松赢下每一轮。
senses.why: The ranked players are pre-planted in fixed positions, like seeds in rows.
senses.whyCN: 被排名的选手像成排的种子一样被预先安置在固定位置。

senses.title: To put seeds in the ground
senses.definition: to place seeds in soil so plants will grow
senses.definitionCN: 把种子放进土壤以便生长
senses.example: They seeded the field with wheat.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在田里播下了小麦。
senses.why: The grain becomes a verb: you do the planting yourself.
senses.whyCN: 颗粒变成动词：由你亲手完成栽种。

senses.title: Seeds or pits of fruit
senses.definition: the small hard parts inside a fruit
senses.definitionCN: 果实内部细小的硬粒
senses.example: Remove the seeds before blending the melon.
senses.exampleCN: 打瓜汁前先把籽去掉。
senses.why: The same kernel hides inside the sweet flesh.
senses.whyCN: 同样的硬粒藏在甜美的果肉里。

intro.en: From Old English saed, related to sowing.
intro.cn: 来自古英语 saed，与「播种」相关。

items.en: The reconstructed root *sehi- means to sow or scatter.
items.cn: 重构词根 *sehi- 意为「播撒」。

items.en: Germanic forms gave both sow and seed from the same idea of scattering.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式从「播撒」这一意象同时产出 sow 与 seed。

items.en: Old English saed meant what is sown: the seed itself.
items.cn: 古英语 saed 意为「被播撒之物」，即种子。

items.en: The spelling became seed, with the double vowel marking length.
items.cn: 中古英语拼写演变为 seed，双元音标记长音。

items.en: Modern use adds beginnings of ideas, ranked players, and the verb to sow.
items.cn: 现代用法新增「起因」「种子选手」及动词「播种」。

note.en: Look-alikes in the seed spelling family, and near words in the beginning field.
note.cn: seed 拼写家族的形近词，以及「开端」义场的近义词。

entries.definitionCN: 寻找——与 seed 仅差词尾一个字母，注意区分
破旧的；可疑的——由 seed 派生，注意词义转移
喂食——拼写与 seed 相近但词源不同
起源——抽象用法近义，seed 更具画面感
来源——强调出处，seed 强调孕育未来的潜能

entries.definition: the central part of a nut or idea
entries.definitionCN: 核心——与果核义项相近，kernel 更抽象

normalIntro.en: Hooks on planting, spelling neighbors, and the tournament bracket.
normalIntro.cn: 基于播种、拼写邻居与赛事对阵表的记忆钩子。

normal.en: sow and seed share the same ancient root of scattering
normal.cn: sow 与 seed 共享古老的「播撒」词根

normal.en: seed of doubt: a feeling that grows like a plant
normal.cn: seed of doubt：像植物一样生长的情绪

normal.en: top seed sits at the top of the bracket like a planted row
normal.cn: 头号种子像成排种下的作物，被安置在对阵表顶端

normal.en: go to seed means the plant has finished and faded
normal.cn: go to seed 表示植物结籽后走向凋零

normal.en: seedling is the baby form, -ling marks smallness
normal.cn: seedling 是「幼苗」，后缀 -ling 标记幼小

abstract.en: Picture pressing one tiny grain into dark soil
abstract.cn: 想象把一粒小小的种子按进黑土

abstract.en: See a doubt growing quietly into a tall thorn bush
abstract.cn: 看见一点疑心悄悄长成高高的荆棘

abstract.en: Feel the tournament chart as a field with fixed rows
abstract.cn: 把对阵表想象成分好行的田地

examples.en: The wind carried the seeds across the valley.
examples.cn: 风把种子吹过山谷。

examples.en: Their argument planted a seed of doubt in my mind.
examples.cn: 他们的争论在我心里埋下了怀疑的种子。

examples.en: She is the second seed in this tournament.
examples.cn: 她是本次赛事的二号种子选手。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西的」——种子是西方传来的？种子落地生根，西的也能长成东的。

root: 古英语 saed「被播撒之物」，与动词 sow（播种）同源，均出自重构的印欧词根 *sehi-「播撒」。起因义、种子选手义与动词义都从「埋进土里的一粒」展开。

sensesIntro.en: From one buried grain grow four directions: new plants, new ideas, new rankings, new fields.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一粒埋进土里的种子长出四个方向：新植物、新想法、新排名、新田地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one grain pressed into dark soil, holding a future
core.cn: 核心意象：一粒按进黑土的种子，装着未来

branches.en: the grain itself, inside fruit or packet
branches.cn: 颗粒本身，在果实或纸袋里

branches.en: a small cause that later fills a field
branches.cn: 日后占满一整片田的小小起因

branches.en: players planted in a fixed bracket
branches.cn: 被安置在固定对阵位置的选手

branches.en: the act of scattering grains by hand
branches.cn: 亲手播撒颗粒的动作

branches.en: grain, cause and sowing share one picture
branches.cn: 颗粒、起因与播种共享同一画面

intro.en: English words grown from the seed and sow family.
intro.cn: 由 seed 与 sow 词族长出的英语词。

items.meaning: a grain that grows into a plant
items.example: Store the seeds in a cool place.
They met in a seedy bar.
items.exampleCN: 他们在一家破旧的酒吧见面。

items.meaning: the first funds to start a project
items.example: The lab was built with seed money.
items.exampleCN: 实验室靠启动资金建成。

items.example: The garden has gone to seed.
Seedless grapes are easier to eat.

items.meaningCN: 喂食——形近但词源不同，来自古英语 fedan
items.example: Please feed the cat at noon.

definition_zh: 寻找；寻求；请求（帮助）
definition_en: to try to find or get something, often with effort and over time
core_image: 一只手在黑暗中四处摸索，朝着微光前进
scene: 求职者翻遍了招聘网站，仍不放弃。Thousands of graduates seek better jobs in big cities every year.
sceneCN: 这里 seek 是「寻找；寻求」（第 1 个义项：努力寻找想要的东西）；句意是每年数以千计的毕业生在大城市寻找更好的工作。

derivatives.zh: seek 加 -er 名词后缀，义为「寻求者；探索者」
sought 加形容词化后缀，义为「抢手的；受追捧的」

senses.title: To try to find something
senses.definition: to search for something you want or need
senses.definitionCN: 搜寻想要或需要的东西
senses.example: Dogs seek food by smell.
senses.exampleCN: 狗靠嗅觉寻找食物。
senses.why: The hand reaches into the dark, moving toward a hint of light.
senses.whyCN: 手伸进黑暗，朝一丝光亮移动。

senses.title: To try to achieve a goal
senses.definition: to attempt to reach or obtain an aim
senses.definitionCN: 努力达成或获得某个目标
senses.example: The party seeks greater freedom for students.
senses.exampleCN: 该党派谋求学生更大的自由。
senses.why: What begins as hunting a thing becomes hunting a future.
senses.whyCN: 从寻找一件东西变成追寻一个未来。

senses.title: To ask for help or permission
senses.definition: to ask someone for help, advice, or approval
senses.definitionCN: 向人请求帮助、建议或许可
senses.example: You should seek legal advice first.
senses.exampleCN: 你应先咨询法律意见。
senses.why: When the light is far away, you ask another lamp to show the way.
senses.whyCN: 当光太远时，你请另一盏灯指路。

senses.title: To try to reach a place or state
senses.definition: to head toward a place, condition, or situation
senses.definitionCN: 朝某个地方、状态或处境前进
senses.example: Refugees seek safety across the border.
senses.exampleCN: 难民越境寻求安全。
senses.why: The movement of seeking ends at a destination — the body follows the search.
senses.whyCN: 寻访的移动终于抵达处所——身体跟随搜寻前行。

senses.title: Naturally tend toward
senses.definition: to move or develop toward a condition automatically
senses.definitionCN: 自然而然地朝某种状态移动或发展
senses.example: Water seeks the lowest level.
senses.exampleCN: 水往低处流。
senses.why: Even without hands, everything quietly slides toward where it belongs.
senses.whyCN: 即使没有手，万物也悄然滑向自己的归属。

intro.en: From Old English secan, related to Latin sagire (to perceive keenly) by some scholars.
intro.cn: 来自古英语 secan，部分学者认为与拉丁语 sagire（敏锐感知）相关。

items.en: A possible root *sag- relates to tracking and perceiving.
items.cn: 可能的词根 *sag- 与追踪、感知相关。

items.en: Germanic sekon meant to seek, and gave Dutch zoeken and German suchen.
items.cn: 日耳曼 sekon 意为寻找，衍生出荷兰语 zoeken、德语 suchen。

items.en: Old English secan meant to look for, aim at, or visit.
items.cn: 古英语 secan 意为寻找、瞄准或拜访。

items.en: The strong past form sought became fixed in Middle English.
items.cn: 强变化过去式 sought 在中古英语中固定下来。

items.en: Modern seek keeps searching, pursuing, and requesting uses.
items.cn: 现代 seek 保留搜寻、追求与请求诸义。

note.en: Look-alikes near the see- spelling, and near rivals in the searching field.
note.cn: see- 拼写附近的形近词，以及搜寻义场的近义词。

entries.definitionCN: 寻找 vs 海——拼写相近，注意词尾区别
偷看——与 seek 拼写相近但词源不同
温顺的——形近词，词义完全不同
搜查——强调仔细翻找的过程，seek 强调目的

entries.definition: to chase or follow a goal
entries.definitionCN: 追求——与「谋求」义项近义，更书面

entries.definition: to chase animals or search hard
entries.definitionCN: 追猎；搜寻——语气更强烈，常用于追捕

normalIntro.en: Hooks on the reaching hand, the irregular past, and spelling neighbors.
normalIntro.cn: 基于伸出的手、不规则过去式与拼写邻居的记忆钩子。

normal.en: seek → sought: the k turns into a gh like think → thought
normal.cn: seek → sought：k 变成 gh，规律同 think → thought

normal.en: water seeks its own level is the famous proverb
normal.cn: 水往低处流是著名谚语，对应第五义项

normal.en: seeker is the person, sought-after is the popular thing
normal.cn: seeker 是人，sought-after 是抢手之物

normal.en: hide and seek: the game keeps the oldest sense
normal.cn: 捉迷藏这个游戏保留了最古老的意义

normal.en: seek advice is the polite way to ask
normal.cn: seek advice 是请求帮助的礼貌说法

abstract.en: Picture hands sweeping a dark attic toward a faint window
abstract.cn: 想象双手在昏暗阁楼里摸索，朝微亮的窗户靠近

abstract.en: Feel yourself leaning forward out of a moving crowd
abstract.cn: 感受自己从涌动的人群中向前倾身

abstract.en: See water quietly choosing the lowest valley
abstract.cn: 看见水悄然选择最低的山谷

examples.en: He sought shelter from the sudden storm.
examples.cn: 他找地方躲避突如其来的风暴。

examples.en: The company seeks new markets in Asia.
examples.cn: 这家公司在亚洲开拓新市场。

examples.en: You should seek a second opinion before surgery.
examples.cn: 手术前你应征求第二意见。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「细抠」——找东西要像细抠细节一样，一点点抠出来才找得到。

root: 古英语 secan「寻找、拜访」，属日耳曼强变化动词，过去式 sought 与 think→thought 同构；远源可能与表「敏锐感知」的词根相关（存疑）。

sensesIntro.en: From groping in the dark grow five directions: finding things, chasing goals, asking for lamps, arriving at shelter, and water finding its level.
sensesIntro.cn: 从黑暗中摸索长出五个方向：找物、追目标、求指引、抵庇护、水归低处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand groping through darkness toward faint light
core.cn: 核心意象：黑暗中伸出的手，朝微光摸索

branches.en: the eye and the hand hunt for what is missing
branches.cn: 眼与手一起搜寻缺失之物

branches.en: the search turns into a long chase of goals
branches.cn: 搜寻变成长久的追逐

branches.en: asking someone else to hold the lamp

branches.en: the whole body moves toward refuge

definition_zh: 似乎；好像；看上去
definition_en: to give a certain impression, especially when judged from appearance or limited information
core_image: 雾里看楼，楼影像真的一样立在雾中，其实未必
scene: 天刚亮，远处山头被薄雾罩着。The village seems quiet from across the river.
sceneCN: 这里 seem 是「看上去」（第 1 个义项：凭外观给人的印象）；句意是从河对岸看，村子显得很安静。

derivatives.zh: seem 加 -ing 与 -ly 副词后缀，义为「表面上；看似」
seem 的现在分词形容词用法，义为「表面的；貌似的」

senses.title: To give an outward impression
senses.definition: to appear to be, judged from outside signs
senses.definitionCN: 根据外部迹象呈现出某种样子
senses.example: The old house seems empty.
senses.exampleCN: 那座老房子看起来是空的。
senses.why: The building in the fog shows a shape, but fog hides what is really there.
senses.whyCN: 雾中的楼显出一个轮廓，但雾遮住了它真实的模样。

senses.title: To appear likely or true
senses.definition: to give the impression that something is true or will happen
senses.definitionCN: 给人某种印象：某事是真的或将发生
senses.example: The plan seems impossible at first.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案起初似乎不可能。
senses.why: The shadow of the tower looks like the tower, and the mind believes the shadow.
senses.whyCN: 塔的影子看起来像塔，头脑便信了影子。

senses.title: To feel from one's viewpoint
senses.definition: to appear in a certain way from the speaker's personal view
senses.definitionCN: 从说话者个人角度呈现出某种感受
senses.example: It seems colder today than yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 今天好像比昨天冷。
senses.why: Your own window colors the fog — impression depends on where you stand.
senses.whyCN: 你自己的窗子给雾染了色——感受取决于你站的位置。

senses.title: Used to soften a statement
senses.definition: a polite way to state an opinion without force
senses.definitionCN: 不带强加感、委婉陈述观点的方式
senses.example: You seem to have forgotten our deal.
senses.exampleCN: 你好像忘了我们的约定。
senses.why: The fog lets you say something without pointing a finger.
senses.whyCN: 雾让你说出某事时，不必用手指着对方。

senses.title: To appear to do something
senses.definition: to give the impression of performing an action
senses.definitionCN: 给人正在做某个动作的印象
senses.example: She seems to read everyone's mind.
senses.exampleCN: 她好像能读出每个人的心思。
senses.why: An outline of a moving figure appears in the mist — motion only seen, never proven.
senses.whyCN: 雾中出现一个移动的人影轮廓——只被看见，未被证实。

intro.en: From Old Norse saemi (becoming, fitting), which merged into Middle English through northern dialects.
intro.cn: 来自古诺斯语 saemi（合适的、相称的），经北方方言并入中古英语。

items.en: A possible root *somos means same or alike, also seen in seemly and same.
items.cn: 可能的词根 *somos 意为「相同的」，也见于 seemly、same。

items.en: Old Norse saemi meant fitting or becoming, built on same-root ideas of likeness.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 saemi 意为合适，其构词基于「相似」的同一词根。

items.en: Northern English adopted semes / semeth to translate French sembler.
items.cn: 北方中古英语用 semes、semeth 对译法语的 sembler。

items.en: The verb spread south and replaced older English befitting verbs.
items.cn: 该动词向南扩散，取代了英语原有的表「合适」的动词。

items.en: Modern seem holds appearance, likelihood, and polite hedging.
items.cn: 现代 seem 承载外观、可能性与委婉语气。

note.en: Look-alikes around the see- shape, and near rivals in the appearing field.
note.cn: see- 形附近的形近词，以及「表象」义场的近义词。

entries.definitionCN: 看见——与 seem 仅差词尾一个字母，词源也不同
得体的——由 seem 的古义「合适」派生的同根词

entries.definition: the line where two pieces are joined
entries.definitionCN: 接缝——同音异义，拼写相近注意区分
显得——近义，appear 更中性，seem 更强调主观判断
看起来——偏视觉，seem 可涵盖各种印象

entries.definition: to look like someone or something
entries.definitionCN: 像——强调相似性本身，seem 强调主观感受

normalIntro.en: Hooks on fog pictures and the seemly connection.
normalIntro.cn: 基于雾中画面与 seemly 关联的记忆钩子。

normal.en: same and seemly share the old root of likeness
normal.cn: same 与 seemly 共享古老的「相似」词根

normal.en: seemly still means proper, the surviving cousin of seem
normal.cn: seemly 至今仍表「得体」，是 seem 的存留亲属

normal.en: nothing is as it seems warns about the fog picture
normal.cn: nothing is as it measures 表象未必为真，正是雾的画面

normal.en: it seems that is softer than it is that
normal.cn: it seems that 比 it is that 语气更委婉

normal.en: seemingly = to all outward appearance
normal.cn: seemingly 表示「从一切外表看」

abstract.en: Picture a tower standing inside moving fog
abstract.cn: 想象一座塔立在流动的雾里

abstract.en: See two shadows on a wall that look like friends
abstract.cn: 看见墙上两个影子看似朋友

abstract.en: Feel your own breath cooling the air you judge
abstract.cn: 体会你自己的呼吸冷却了你所判断的空气

examples.en: The new intern seems capable and calm.
examples.cn: 新来的实习生看起来干练又沉稳。

examples.en: It seems that the train is already gone.
examples.cn: 火车似乎已经开走了。

examples.en: There seems to be a problem with the signal.
examples.cn: 信号似乎出了问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「似姆」——似，就是「似乎」的似，见字读音直接命中。

root: 古诺斯语 saemi「合适的、相称的」，出自表「相同、相似」的词根（与 same、seemly 同源）；中古英语在北方方言中先用作「合适」，后转为「貌似、似乎」。

sensesIntro.en: One foggy shape, five readings: outside looks, likely truth, private feeling, soft words, ghost motions.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个雾中轮廓，五种读法：外表、可能的真相、私人心感、委婉措辞、虚晃动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a building half hidden in fog, shape without proof
core.cn: 核心意象：半隐于雾中的楼，只见轮廓不见实体

branches.en: what the eye takes in from a distance
branches.cn: 远距离观望所得的第一眼

branches.en: the mind deciding the shadow is the tower
branches.cn: 头脑把影子当成了塔本身

branches.en: the view tinted by your own window
branches.cn: 被你自己的窗色染过的视野

branches.en: the fog softening every blunt statement
branches.cn: 雾把生硬的话都变得柔和

branches.en: a moving outline that may not be real
branches.cn: 可能并不真实的移动轮廓

intro.cn: 与 seem 及其「相似」词根相关的英语词。

items.meaning: to appear or give an impression
items.example: The task seems easy until you start.
items.exampleCN: 动手之前任务显得很容易。
他们表面的平静藏着慌乱。

items.example: Seemingly simple, the recipe took hours.
items.exampleCN: 看似简单，这道菜却花了数小时。

items.meaningCN: 显得；出现——近义但词源不同，来自拉丁 apparere
items.example: A door appeared in the wall.

items.meaningCN: 看；看起来——近义但为本族词

definition_zh: 抓住；夺取；扣押；突然发作
definition_en: to take hold of something quickly and firmly, often by force
core_image: 一只手猛地钳住猎物，毫不松开
scene: 海关检查到可疑包裹，执法人员立刻行动。Customs officers seized the illegal goods at the harbor.
sceneCN: 这里 seize 是「扣押；没收」（第 3 个义项：依法强制占有）；句意是海关人员在港口查扣了违禁品。

derivatives.zh: seize 加 -ure 名词后缀，义为「 seizure 抓取；没收；癫痫发作」
seize 加 -er 名词后缀，义为「夺取者；抓捕者」

senses.title: To grab quickly and firmly
senses.definition: to take hold of something suddenly with force
senses.definitionCN: 突然用力抓住某物
senses.example: The policeman seized the thief's arm.
senses.exampleCN: 警察一把抓住小偷的手臂。
senses.why: The claw closes in one snap and nothing escapes.
senses.whyCN: 爪子瞬间合拢，猎物无处可逃。

senses.title: To take by force or power
senses.definition: to take control of a place or position using force
senses.definitionCN: 用武力或权力占据某地或某职位
senses.example: The army seized the capital in one night.
senses.exampleCN: 军队一夜之间攻占了首都。
senses.why: The claw becomes an army: whole cities snap shut in one grip.
senses.whyCN: 爪子变成军队：整座城市被一握合拢。

senses.title: To confiscate legally
senses.definition: to take property officially under the law
senses.definitionCN: 依法正式收走财物
senses.example: Police seized three cars in the fraud case.
senses.exampleCN: 警方在该诈骗案中扣押了三辆车。
senses.why: The state's hand closes around property, the legal version of the grip.
senses.whyCN: 国家的手合拢于财产之上——这就是抓握的法律版本。

senses.title: To grip the mind or body suddenly
senses.definition: to take hold of a person's mind or body at once
senses.definitionCN: 突然攫住人的心神或身体
senses.example: She was seized by a sudden cough.
senses.exampleCN: 她突然剧烈咳嗽起来。
senses.why: An invisible claw snaps around the chest or the nerves.
senses.whyCN: 一只看不见的爪子骤然合拢于胸口或神经。

senses.title: To use a chance eagerly
senses.definition: to take an opportunity immediately and eagerly
senses.definitionCN: 立即且热切地抓住机会
senses.example: He seized every chance to speak English.
senses.exampleCN: 他抓住一切机会说英语。
senses.why: The claw closes on time itself — the moment becomes the prey.
senses.whyCN: 爪子合拢于时间——那一刻成了猎物。

intro.en: From Old French saisir, which came from a Germanic word meaning to take possession.
intro.cn: 来自古法语 saisir，其源头是日耳曼语中表「占有」的词。

items.en: The likely source is a Germanic root meaning to take hold or sit upon, also linked to seat.
items.cn: 可能源自日耳曼词根，意为「抓住、坐据」，与 seat 有亲缘关联。

items.en: Old French saisir meant to take possession, especially of feudal property.
items.cn: 古法语 saisir 意为占有，尤指取得封建地产。

items.en: English law borrowed the word for taking property by legal authority.
items.cn: 英格兰法律借用该词表示依法占有财产。

items.en: Seize entered English in the 1400s with both grabbing and legal senses.
items.cn: 十五世纪 seize 进入英语，兼有抓取与法律占取二义。

items.en: Modern use adds seizing power, moments, emotions, and medical fits.
items.cn: 现代用法扩展到夺取政权、把握时机、情绪袭扰与医学发作。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sei- spelling family, and near rivals in the grabbing field.
note.cn: sei- 拼写家族的形近词，以及抓取义场的近义词。

围攻——与 seize 同出一脉，均为「占取」的军事化表达
猛抓——口语色彩更强，seize 更正式
抓紧；理解——兼有比喻理解义
没收——与扣押义项近义，更书面

normalIntro.en: Hooks on the snapping claw and the siege connection.
normalIntro.cn: 基于猛合的爪子与 siege 关联的记忆钩子。

normal.en: siege and seize share one root: to take possession
normal.cn: siege 与 seize 同根，都表示「占有」

normal.en: size and seize differ by one letter and one vowel sound
normal.cn: size 与 seize 只差一个字母与一个元音

normal.en: seize the day means grab the moment with both hands
normal.cn: seize the day 就是双手抓住当下

normal.en: a seizure of assets is the legal claw
normal.cn: 扣押资产就是法律之爪

normal.en: be seized by fear: an emotion with teeth
normal.cn: be seized by fear：长着牙齿的情绪

abstract.en: Picture a falcon closing its talons in mid-air
abstract.cn: 想象猎鹰在空中猛然合拢利爪

abstract.en: See a gate slamming shut on a whole city
abstract.cn: 看见城门轰然合拢，围住整座城

abstract.en: Feel panic wrapping around your chest in one grip
abstract.cn: 体会恐慌一把攫住胸口的感觉

examples.en: The rebel leader seized the radio station first.
examples.cn: 叛军首领首先夺取了广播电台。

examples.en: Officers seized a shipment of fake medicine.
examples.cn: 官员们查扣了一批假药。

examples.en: A sudden panic seized the whole crowd.
examples.cn: 一阵恐慌突然笼罩了人群。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西子」——西子湖畔一把抓住，抓西湖美女的手可要又快又稳。

sensesIntro.en: One snapping claw, five grips: the thief's arm, the capital, the assets, the nerves, the fleeting moment.
sensesIntro.cn: 一只猛合的爪子，五次抓握：小偷的手臂、首都、资产、神经与转瞬即逝的时机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a claw snapping shut around its prey
core.cn: 核心意象：利爪骤然合拢，钳住猎物

branches.en: the first physical snap of the hand
branches.cn: 手的第一次物理性抓合

branches.en: the snap scaled up to armies and cities
branches.cn: 爪子放大为军队与城市

branches.en: the grip wearing legal gloves
branches.cn: 戴上了法律手套的抓握

branches.en: the claw reaching into mind and body
branches.cn: 爪子伸进了心神与身体

branches.en: time itself caught in the grip
branches.cn: 连时间也被攥在爪中

intro.en: Words built on seize and its French-Germanic family.
intro.cn: 由 seize 及其法语-日耳曼词族构成的英语词。

items.exampleCN: 被没收的手机后来归还了。

definition_zh: 挑选；选拔；精选的
definition_en: to choose from a group by thinking carefully about which is best
core_image: 站在货架前伸出的手，在一排物品中点住一个
scene: 教练在训练场来回踱步，反复端详。The coach will select six players for the national team.
sceneCN: 这里 select 是「选拔」（第 2 个义项：从多人中慎重选出）；句意是教练将为国家队挑选六名球员。

derivatives.zh: select 加 -ion 名词后缀，义为「选择；选集」
select 加 -ive 形容词后缀，义为「选择的；挑剔的」
select 加 -or 名词后缀，义为「选择者；选择器」
selective 加 -ly，义为「有选择地」

senses.title: To choose one from many
senses.definition: to pick out one or more items from a larger group
senses.definitionCN: 从较大的一组中挑出一个或几个
senses.example: Please select your language on the screen.
senses.exampleCN: 请在屏幕上选择你的语言。
senses.why: The hand hovers, compares, and finally rests on one item.
senses.whyCN: 手悬停、比较，最终停在某一件上。

senses.title: To pick people for a role
senses.definition: to choose people for a job, team, or honor
senses.definitionCN: 为职务、队伍或荣誉挑选人
senses.example: She was selected to lead the project.
senses.exampleCN: 她被选中领导这个项目。
senses.why: The hand now points at a person, not a thing.
senses.whyCN: 这一次手指向的是人，不是物。

senses.title: To set apart as best quality
senses.definition: chosen carefully as being of high quality
senses.definitionCN: 经精心挑选的高品质事物
senses.example: The shop sells select teas from Yunnan.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店出售云南精选茶叶。
senses.why: What the hand picked once now stands apart as the best shelf.
senses.whyCN: 被手挑过的东西，如今单独摆上了最好的货架。

senses.title: To isolate with care
senses.definition: to treat or affect only chosen parts
senses.definitionCN: 只针对选定的部分处理或作用
senses.example: The drug selectively kills cancer cells.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药有选择地杀死癌细胞。
senses.why: The hand touches only the marked ones and leaves the rest.
senses.whyCN: 手只触碰标记过的人，其余一概不碰。

senses.title: To determine by choice
senses.definition: to be decided by someone's act of choosing
senses.definitionCN: 由某人的选择行为决定
senses.example: Your grade is selected by your own effort.
senses.exampleCN: 你的成绩由你自己的努力决定。
senses.why: The shelf ends up shaped by where the hand once pointed.
senses.whyCN: 货架最终的样子，取决于手曾经指向哪里。

intro.en: From Latin seligere, built on se- (apart) and legere (to gather, pick).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 seligere，由 se-（分开）与 legere（收集、挑选）构成。

items.en: The root *leg- means to gather or collect, shared with lecture and legal.
items.cn: 词根 *leg- 意为「收集」，也与 lecture、legal 同源。

items.en: Seligere means to pick out separately, se- adding the idea of apartness.
items.cn: 拉丁语 seligere 意为「挑出」，前缀 se- 增加「分离」之意。

items.en: The participle selectus became the adjective form in Romance languages.
items.cn: 过去分词 selectus 在罗曼语中转为形容词形式。

items.en: English took the word from Latin selectus in the 1500s.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪直接借入拉丁语 selectus。

items.en: Modern select covers choosing, selecting people, and premium goods.
items.cn: 现代 select 涵盖挑选、选人与精选商品。

note.en: Look-alikes in the -lect family, and near rivals in the choosing field.
note.cn: -lect 词族的形近词，以及「选择」义场的近义词。

选举——同根，elect 强调投票
忽视——同根负向：neglect 是「不挑不管」
选择——本族词，泛指一切选择
挑——口语随意，select 更慎重

entries.definition: to make a choice between options
entries.definitionCN: 选择——强调在选项间抉择

normalIntro.en: Hooks on the -lect family and the hovering hand.
normalIntro.cn: 基于 -lect 词族与悬停之手的记忆钩子。

normal.cn: se-（分开）+ lect（收集）：分开来收，就是挑选

normal.cn: elect 投票选，collect 收集，select 精挑

normal.en: selection is the noun, selective is the picky adjective
normal.cn: selection 是名词，selective 是挑剔的形容词

normal.en: a select club admits only the chosen few
normal.cn: a select club 只收被选中的少数人

normal.en: randomly select still uses the careful hand, just blindfolded
normal.cn: randomly select 仍是那只手，只是蒙了眼

abstract.en: Picture a finger hovering over a keyboard of choices
abstract.cn: 想象手指悬停在一排选项按键上

abstract.en: See a hand moving along a shelf, pausing, lifting one jar
abstract.cn: 看见手沿货架移动，停住，拿起一只罐子

abstract.en: Feel the pride of being the one picked out
abstract.cn: 体会被挑中那一刻的自豪

examples.en: You can select three dishes from the set menu.
examples.cn: 你可以从套餐菜单中选三道菜。

examples.en: The committee selected her design for the new bridge.
examples.cn: 委员会选中了她的新桥设计方案。

examples.en: Only a select few were invited to the dinner.
examples.cn: 只有少数精英获邀出席晚宴。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「洗来客特」——挑选像洗菜一样仔细，把来的客人一个个特挑出来。

sensesIntro.en: One pointing hand, five gestures: picking things, choosing people, marking the premium shelf, touching only some, deciding the outcome.

branches.en: the basic act of picking one item out
branches.cn: 从一排中挑出一件的基本动作

branches.en: the same hand choosing a person instead
branches.cn: 同一只手指向了人

branches.en: the chosen ones standing on a special shelf
branches.cn: 被选中的摆上特殊货架

branches.en: one gesture covers goods and people alike
branches.cn: 同一动作涵盖物与人

definition_zh: 选择；挑选；选集；被选中者
definition_en: the act of choosing someone or something from a group, or the group of chosen items
core_image: 货架前放下的一只小推车，装着被挑出的几件
scene: 评委翻阅完所有报名作品，开始圈定入围名单。The final selection of paintings will hang in the city hall.
sceneCN: 这里 selection 是「入选作品」（第 4 个义项：被选中的一组东西）；句意是最终入选的画作将悬挂在市政厅。

derivatives.zh: selection 的动词与形容词同根形式，义为「挑选；精选的」
select 加 -ive，义为「有选择性的；挑剔的」
select 加 -ee，义为「被选中者」

senses.title: The act of choosing
senses.definition: the process of deciding which person or thing to take
senses.definitionCN: 决定取用某人某物的过程
senses.example: Selection of the winner took two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 挑选获胜者花了两个小时。
senses.why: The cart moves slowly along the shelf while choices are made.
senses.whyCN: 推车沿货架缓缓移动，选择正在发生。

senses.title: The range available to choose from
senses.definition: the set of items offered for choosing
senses.definitionCN: 供人挑选的一组东西
senses.example: The menu has a wide selection of dishes.
senses.exampleCN: 菜单提供了丰富的菜品选择。
senses.why: The whole shelf lies open before the cart.
senses.whyCN: 整个货架都摊开在推车面前。

senses.title: Someone or something chosen
senses.definition: the person or item that gets picked
senses.definitionCN: 最终被挑中的那个人或那件物
senses.example: He was the committee's first selection.
senses.exampleCN: 他是委员会的首选之人。
senses.why: One item leaves the shelf and lands in the cart.
senses.whyCN: 一件物品离开货架，落进推车。

senses.title: A group of chosen items
senses.definition: a collection of things chosen from a larger set
senses.definitionCN: 从更大集合中选出的一组
senses.example: This album is a selection of her best songs.
senses.exampleCN: 这张专辑是她最佳歌曲的选集。
senses.why: The cart rolls away full, leaving the shelf behind.
senses.whyCN: 推车满载离去，货架留在身后。

senses.title: Evolutionary survival of the fittest
senses.definition: the natural process where some organisms survive and reproduce more
senses.definitionCN: 部分生物更易存活繁殖的自然过程
senses.example: Natural selection favors faster animals.
senses.exampleCN: 自然选择偏爱更快的动物。
senses.why: The invisible cart of nature keeps only the strongest items.
senses.whyCN: 自然那只看不见的推车只保留最强的个体。

intro.en: From Latin selectio, the noun of seligere (to pick out).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 selectio，即 seligere（挑出）的名词形式。

items.en: The root *leg- again means to gather, the same source as select.
items.cn: 词根 *leg- 同样表「收集」，与 select 同源。

items.en: Selectio means a picking out, formed from seligere with -io.
items.cn: 拉丁语 selectio 由 seligere 加 -io 构成，意为「挑取」。

items.en: Roman writers used selectio for sorting and literary choice.
items.cn: 罗马作家用 selectio 表示整理与文学选材。

items.en: English borrowed selection in the 1500s for acts of choosing.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 selection 表示选择行为。

items.en: Darwin fixed natural selection as a scientific term in 1859.
items.cn: 达尔文于 1859 年将 natural selection 确立为科学术语。

note.en: Look-alikes in the -lection family, and near rivals in the choosing field.
note.cn: -lection 词族的形近词，以及「选择」义场的近义词。

entries.definition: a choice or the best one

examples.en: Random selection makes the lottery fair.
examples.cn: 随机抽取保证了彩票的公平。

examples.en: Her selection for the team surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 她入选队伍让所有人都很意外。

definition_zh: 自己；自我；本性；（使）一致
definition_en: the whole being of a person, including body and mind, considered as a distinct identity
core_image: 镜子里的那个人，和你动作分毫不差
scene: 深夜卧室里，她对着穿衣镜站了很久。She finally accepted her true self after years of doubt.
sceneCN: 这里 self 是「自我；本性」（第 2 个义项：内在的真实身份）；句意是多年怀疑之后，她终于接纳了真实的自我。

derivatives.zh: self 加 -ish，义为「自私的」
self 加 -less，义为「无私的」
self 与 my 构成反身代词，义为「我自己」
self 与 one 构成反身代词，义为「自己」

senses.title: Your whole person as distinct from others
senses.definition: the entire person regarded apart from everyone else
senses.definitionCN: 与所有人区分开来的整个个人
senses.example: Keep the secret between your self and the diary.
senses.exampleCN: 把这个秘密留在你和日记之间。
senses.why: The mirror figure is not anyone else — it is exactly the one standing there.
senses.whyCN: 镜中人不是别人——正是站在那里的人。

senses.title: The inner identity or nature
senses.definition: the deeper identity made of feelings, beliefs, and character
senses.definitionCN: 由情感、信念与性格构成的更深层身份
senses.example: Travel helped him find his true self.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行帮他找到了真实的自我。
senses.why: The mirror shows more than the face: it shows who is behind it.
senses.whyCN: 镜子照出的不止是脸，还有脸背后的人。

senses.title: Personal interest or advantage
senses.definition: one's own benefit considered selfishly
senses.definitionCN: 从私己角度考虑的利益
senses.example: He always puts self before the team.
senses.exampleCN: 他总是把私利放在团队之前。
senses.why: The mirror figure is the only one the greedy eye serves.
senses.whyCN: 贪婪的眼睛只服务于镜中人。

senses.title: Same origin, same make, or unchanged state
senses.definition: belonging to the same origin or remaining unchanged
senses.definitionCN: 出自同一来源或保持原样
senses.example: The valley keeps its self after all the changes.
senses.exampleCN: 山谷历经变迁仍保持本色。
senses.why: The mirror never changes the figure — same face, same frame.
senses.whyCN: 镜子从不改变人影——同样的脸，同样的框。

senses.title: A combined form meaning one's own
senses.definition: a combining element meaning of oneself
senses.definitionCN: 表示「自身的」构词成分
senses.example: She checked the answer herself.
senses.exampleCN: 她亲自核对了答案。
senses.why: The mirror multiplies into every corner of the language: self-care, self-portrait.
senses.whyCN: 镜子在语言各个角落复制自己：self-care、self-portrait。

intro.en: From Old English self, one of the oldest identity words in Germanic languages.
intro.cn: 来自古英语 self，是日耳曼诸语言中最古老的「身份」词之一。

items.en: The root *selbho- likely meant own or distinct, the seed of identity words.
items.cn: 词根 *selbho- 可能意为「自己的、独特的」，是身份类词汇的种子。

items.en: Germanic languages all built their self words on this root: Dutch zelf, German selbe.
items.cn: 日耳曼诸语言的「自身」词都基于此根：荷兰语 zelf、德语 selbe。

items.en: Old English self served both as adjective (same) and noun (the person).
items.cn: 古英语 self 兼作形容词（同一的）与名词（本人）。

items.en: Reflexive compounds like myself and himself exploded in Middle English.
items.cn: myself、himself 等反身复合词在中古英语大量涌现。

items.en: Modern self anchors hundreds of compounds, from selfie to self-esteem.
items.cn: 现代 self 构成数百个复合词，从 selfie 到 self-esteem。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sel- shape, and near rivals in the identity field.
note.cn: sel- 形附近的形近词，以及「身份」义场的近义词。

abstract.cn: 看见你移动时镜中人也纹丝不动

abstract.en: Feel the quiet moment when the mask comes off

examples.en: She looked at her aging self in the photograph.
examples.cn: 她端详着照片里日渐老去的自己。

examples.en: Meditation helped him quiet his restless self.
examples.cn: 冥想帮平息了他焦躁的内心。

examples.en: He repaired the bicycle by himself.
examples.cn: 他独自修好了自行车。

branches.en: the face that never changes in the glass
branches.cn: 镜中那张从不改变的脸

branches.en: person and nature in one reflected frame
branches.cn: 人与本性同在一个映像框里

definition_zh: 卖；出售；推销；使被接受
definition_en: to give something in exchange for money
core_image: 摊主把货物递出去，钱进了钱箱
scene: 早市开门，果农把橘子摆上摊位。He sells fresh oranges at the corner market every weekend.
sceneCN: 这里 sell 是「卖」（第 1 个义项：换取金钱）；句意是他每个周末都在街角市场卖新鲜橙子。

derivatives.zh: sell 加 -er 名词后缀，义为「卖家；畅销品」
sell 的古同源名词，义为「销售；特价」
best 加 seller 复合，义为「畅销书」

senses.title: To exchange for money
senses.definition: to give goods or services in return for money
senses.definitionCN: 以商品或服务换取金钱
senses.example: The shop sells fresh bread daily.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店每天出售新鲜面包。
senses.why: The goods leave the stall and the coins arrive — a clean exchange.
senses.whyCN: 货物离摊，硬币到手——一次干净的交换。

senses.title: To have buyers or be bought in numbers
senses.definition: to be bought by many people
senses.definitionCN: 被很多人购买
senses.example: Her novels sell millions of copies.
senses.exampleCN: 她的小说卖出数百万册。
senses.why: The stall keeps emptying on its own — buyers come without pushing.
senses.whyCN: 摊位自己不断清空——买家不请自来。

senses.title: To persuade someone to accept an idea
senses.definition: to make someone believe in or accept a plan
senses.definitionCN: 使人相信或接受某个主张
senses.example: He sold the board on the new strategy.
senses.exampleCN: 他说服董事会接受新战略。
senses.why: No goods change hands, yet the same transfer happens: belief for approval.
senses.whyCN: 货没出手，但同样的转让发生了：用说服换认可。

senses.title: To betray for gain
senses.definition: to give up someone or something for money or benefit
senses.definitionCN: 为金钱或利益放弃某人某事
senses.example: He would never sell his friends.
senses.exampleCN: 他绝不会出卖朋友。
senses.why: The exchange turns dark: loyalty itself goes on the stall.
senses.whyCN: 交换变得黑暗：连忠诚也被摆上了摊位。

senses.title: To cause acceptance by being convincing
senses.definition: to be convincing enough to be accepted
senses.definitionCN: 有说服力到被接受的程度
senses.example: The film sells the dream of small-town life.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影把小镇生活的梦想讲得让人信服。
senses.why: The stall needs no seller — the goods persuade by themselves.
senses.whyCN: 摊位无需叫卖——货品自己就能说服人。

intro.en: From Old English sellan, which originally meant to give — even for free.
intro.cn: 来自古英语 sellan，其原义是「给予」，甚至包括无偿给予。

items.en: A root *delh- or similar relates to giving and handing over.
items.cn: 相关词根与「给予、交付」有关。

items.en: Germanic sellan meant to give or hand over, not yet only for money.
items.cn: 日耳曼 sellan 意为给予、交付，尚不限于金钱。

items.en: Old English sellan could mean to give, deliver, or sacrifice.
items.cn: 古英语 sellan 可表示给予、交付或献祭。

items.en: The money sense narrowed the word: giving became selling.
items.cn: 金钱义使词义收窄：给予变成了售卖。

items.en: Modern sell adds bestsellers, selling ideas, and betrayal.
items.cn: 现代 sell 新增畅销、推销想法与出卖诸义。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sell shape, and near rivals in the trading field.
note.cn: sell 拼写附近的形近词，以及交易义场的近义词。

abstract.en: Feel the handshake that closes an invisible deal
abstract.cn: 体会成交一笔无形交易时的握手

examples.en: They sold their car to pay for the trip.
examples.cn: 他们卖了车来支付旅行费用。

examples.en: Her paintings sell well among young collectors.
examples.cn: 她的画在年轻藏家中很畅销。

examples.en: The team sold the new plan to city officials.
examples.cn: 团队向市政官员推销了新方案。

definition_zh: 寄；发送；派遣；使进入
definition_en: to make something or someone go from one place to another
core_image: 信件脱手飞出，沿一条看不见的线飞向远方
scene: 除夕夜，她写完最后一行祝福。She will send the letter to her grandmother tomorrow.

senses.title: To dispatch a thing by post or channel
senses.definition: to make a letter, parcel, or message travel to a receiver
senses.definitionCN: 让信件、包裹或消息抵达接收方
senses.example: Please send the file before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 请中午前发送文件。
senses.why: The letter leaves the hand and travels along its invisible line.
senses.whyCN: 信离手而行，沿一条看不见的线前进。

senses.title: To cause someone to go somewhere
senses.definition: to make a person go to a place for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 让人为某个目的前往某地
senses.example: They sent an engineer to fix the line.
senses.exampleCN: 他们派工程师来修线路。
senses.why: Now a person rides the same invisible line to its far end.
senses.whyCN: 这次坐上那条线的是人，一直被送到线的远端。

senses.title: To direct something into a state
senses.definition: to cause a person or thing to enter a condition
senses.definitionCN: 使某人某物进入某种状态
senses.example: The news sent the whole city into panic.
senses.exampleCN: 消息使全城陷入恐慌。
senses.why: The line does not end at a place but at a state of mind.
senses.whyCN: 这条线的终点不是地点，而是心境。

senses.title: To make something move suddenly
senses.definition: to cause a sudden fast movement
senses.definitionCN: 引起突然的快速移动
senses.example: The kick sent the ball over the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 一脚把球踢过了墙。
senses.why: A short jolt and the thing is flying — no road needed.
senses.whyCN: 轻轻一震，物已飞出——无需道路。

senses.title: To order goods or people away
senses.definition: to cause someone to leave a place
senses.definitionCN: 让某人离开某处
senses.example: The judge sent him away for ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 法官判他入狱十年。
senses.why: The line now drags the person to a place he never chose.
senses.whyCN: 这条线如今把人拖向他从未选择的地方。

intro.en: From Old English sendan, the causative of a word meaning to go.
intro.cn: 来自古英语 sendan，它是表「去」的使动形式。

items.en: A possible root *sent- means to head toward or go.
items.cn: 可能的词根 *sent- 意为「朝某方向去」。

items.en: Germanic forms gave sendan (cause to go) beside gan (go).
items.cn: 日耳曼形式在 gan（去）之外派生出 sendan（使去）。

items.en: Old English sendan meant to send, send forth, or dispatch.
items.cn: 古英语 sendan 意为寄送、发出、派遣。

items.en: The past form sent became fixed, like the model of lend → lent.
items.cn: 过去式 sent 固定下来，模式如同 lend → lent。

items.en: Modern send covers letters, people, states, and sudden flights.
items.cn: 现代 send 涵盖寄信、派人、致入状态与骤然移动。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sen- shape, and near rivals in the dispatching field.
note.cn: sen- 形附近的形近词，以及「发送」义场的近义词。

definition_zh: 年长的；资深的；上级；高年级学生
definition_en: older or higher in rank, length of service, or position
core_image: 长桌尽头坐着的那个白头发的人，人人先向他致意
scene: 新员工报到那天，先被引到走廊尽头的办公室。The senior engineer approved the final design on Friday.

senses.title: Older in age
senses.definition: being older than another person
senses.definitionCN: 比另一个人年纪大
senses.example: She is two years senior to me.
senses.exampleCN: 她比我年长两岁。
senses.why: The head of the table is the one with the longest years.
senses.whyCN: 坐在长桌尽头的是岁月最长的那个人。

senses.title: Higher in rank or length of service
senses.definition: holding a higher position or longer service
senses.definitionCN: 职位更高或服务年限更长
senses.example: A senior editor reviews every report.
senses.exampleCN: 每篇报道都由资深编辑审阅。
senses.why: The white-haired seat at the table is earned, not inherited.
senses.whyCN: 长桌尽头的白发席位是挣来的，不是继承的。

senses.title: A person of higher rank
senses.definition: a person with a higher position than yours
senses.definitionCN: 职级在你之上的人
senses.example: Please check the plan with your senior.
senses.exampleCN: 请与你的上级核对方案。
senses.why: The person in that seat can send yours back for redrafting.
senses.whyCN: 坐在那个席位上的人可以把你的方案打回重写。

senses.title: A student in the final year
senses.definition: a student in the last year of school

senses.example: My senior taught me the lab rules.
senses.exampleCN: 高年级学长教我实验室规则。
senses.why: The oldest seat in the classroom belongs to those leaving soon.
senses.whyCN: 教室里最年长的座位属于即将离校的人。

senses.title: A person of advanced age
senses.definition: an older person, often retired
senses.definitionCN: 年纪较大、通常已退休的人
senses.example: Buses give free rides to seniors.
senses.exampleCN: 公交车对老年人免费。
senses.why: The long table of years ends where the white hair rests.
senses.whyCN: 岁月的长桌止于白发安坐之处。

intro.en: From Latin senior, the comparative of senex (old man).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 senior，即 senex（老人）的比较级。

items.en: The root *sen- means old, also seen in Senate.
items.cn: 词根 *sen- 意为「老的」，也见于 Senate（元老院）。

items.en: Senex means old man; senior is its comparative, meaning older.
items.cn: 拉丁语 senex 意为老人；senior 是其比较级，意为「更老的」。

items.en: The word traveled through Old French senur into English law and titles.
items.cn: 该词经古法语 senur 进入英格兰的法律与头衔用语。

items.en: English adopted senior in the 1200s for fathers and namesakes.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 senior，用于区分父子同名。

items.en: Modern use spans age, rank, school years, and retirement.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖年龄、职级、学段与退休。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sen- family, and near rivals in the rank field.
note.cn: sen- 词族的形近词，以及职级义场的近义词。

definition_zh: 感觉；感官；判断力；意义；意识到
definition_en: a power of the body or mind to notice things; the meaning of something; good judgment
core_image: 五扇小窗开在身上，世界从窗中涌进来
scene: 走进厨房，烤箱的门刚刚打开。The sense of warm bread reached everyone in the hallway.

senses.title: A power of the body to notice
senses.definition: one of the five powers that receive outside information
senses.definitionCN: 接收外界信息的五种身体能力
senses.example: Sight is the sense we trust the most.
senses.exampleCN: 视觉是我们最信赖的感官。
senses.why: Five windows open on the body, each letting a different wind in.
senses.whyCN: 身上开着五扇窗，各迎一种风。

senses.title: A feeling or awareness
senses.definition: an inner feeling about a situation or quality
senses.definitionCN: 对处境或性质的内心感受
senses.example: A sense of danger made him turn back.
senses.exampleCN: 危险的感觉让他折返。
senses.why: A sixth window opens inward, toward what cannot be seen.
senses.whyCN: 第六扇窗向内开，朝向看不见之物。

senses.title: The meaning of a word or phrase
senses.definition: what a word or action means
senses.definitionCN: 词语或行为所表达的意思

senses.exampleCN: 这个词有狭义和广义之分。
senses.why: Each window frames one view of the same world.
senses.whyCN: 每扇窗都框住同一个世界的一种风景。

senses.title: Good practical judgment
senses.definition: the ability to make sensible decisions
senses.definitionCN: 做出明智决定的能力
senses.example: She has the sense not to argue back.
senses.exampleCN: 她有分寸，不会顶撞回去。
senses.why: The windows sort what enters: nonsense stays outside.
senses.whyCN: 各窗只放进有用的东西：无稽之谈被挡在外面。

senses.title: To become aware of something
senses.definition: to notice something without being told
senses.definitionCN: 无人告知便有所察觉

senses.exampleCN: 他察觉到房间里的紧张气氛。
senses.why: The windows tremble before the storm arrives.
senses.whyCN: 风暴未至，窗已先颤。

items.en: A root *sent- means to head toward or take direction, later stretched to feeling.

items.en: Sentire means to perceive; sensus is the resulting feeling or capacity.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sentire 意为感知；sensus 是由此产生的感觉或能力。

items.en: Sensus covered bodily senses, moral feeling, and meaning.

items.en: Old French sens carried the word into medieval learning.

items.en: English adopted sense in the 1300s with both feeling and meaning uses.

definition_zh: 明智的；合理的；实用的
definition_en: showing good judgment; practical rather than emotional or extreme
core_image: 出门前看一眼天气预报再决定穿什么的人
scene: 出发前，她查了天气又检查了背包。It is sensible to carry an umbrella in this season.
sceneCN: 这里 sensible 是「明智的；合理的」（第 1 个义项：显示出良好判断）；句意是这个季节带伞是明智之举。

derivatives.zh: sensible 加 -ly 副词后缀，义为「明智地；合理地」
sense 家族名词，义为「感受力；情感（常用复数）」

senses.title: Showing good judgment
senses.definition: acting or deciding in a reasonable way
senses.definitionCN: 以合理的方式行动或决定
senses.example: It was sensible to sell the shares early.
senses.exampleCN: 早点卖掉股票是明智的。
senses.why: The man checks the sky before every journey.
senses.whyCN: 此人每次上路前都先看看天。

senses.title: Practical rather than fancy
senses.definition: useful and plain instead of decorative or showy
senses.definitionCN: 朴素实用而不追求花哨
senses.example: She wore sensible boots for the farm visit.
senses.exampleCN: 参观农场时她穿了实用的靴子。
senses.why: The umbrella beats the silk hat when rain is promised.
senses.whyCN: 天气预报有雨时，伞胜过丝礼帽。

senses.title: Aware of something (formal or old use)
senses.definition: able to be felt or noticed
senses.definitionCN: 能被感觉到或注意到的（正式旧用法）
senses.example: He was sensible of the danger around him.
senses.exampleCN: 他察觉到四周的危险。
senses.why: The sky itself is felt, not seen, before the rain.
senses.whyCN: 落雨之前，天色是被感觉到的，而非被看见的。

senses.title: Reasonable in amount or degree
senses.definition: moderate and avoiding extremes
senses.definitionCN: 适度、不走极端
senses.example: Ask for a sensible price, not the moon.
senses.exampleCN: 要个合理的价格，别狮子大开口。
senses.why: The sky-watcher also knows when the rain is light enough to walk through.
senses.whyCN: 看天的人也知道，雨不大时可以直接走过。

intro.en: From Latin sensibilis, able to be felt, from sentire (to feel).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 sensibilis「可被感知的」，源于 sentire（感受）。

items.en: The direction-feeling root *sent- again underlies the family.
items.cn: 定向-感知词根 *sent- 同样支撑这个家族。

items.en: Sensibilis means capable of being sensed, from sensus with -ibilis.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sensibilis 由 sensus 加 -ibilis 构成，意为可被感知的。

items.en: Old French sensible carried both perceptible and emotional meanings.
items.cn: 古法语 sensible 兼有可感知与多情的含义。

items.en: English first used sensible for what can be felt.
items.cn: 英语起初用 sensible 表示可被感知之物。

items.en: By the 1700s the meaning shifted toward wise and practical judgment.
items.cn: 至十八世纪词义转向明智、务实的判断。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sensi- family, and near rivals in the judgment field.
note.cn: sensi- 词族的形近词，以及「判断」义场的近义词。

definition_zh: 敏感的；易受影响的；灵敏的；体贴的
definition_en: quick to feel, notice, or be affected by something
core_image: 含羞草的叶子，指尖一碰就轻轻合拢

senses.title: Quick to react to physical things
senses.definition: reacting strongly to touch, light, cold, or substances
senses.definitionCN: 对触碰、光线、寒冷或物质反应强烈
senses.example: Her sensitive skin reddens in the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 她的敏感肌肤在阳光下会发红。
senses.why: The mimosa leaf folds before the finger even lands.
senses.whyCN: 指尖未落，含羞草叶已合拢。

senses.title: Able to notice feelings
senses.titleCN: 善解人意的；情感敏锐的
senses.definition: good at understanding other people's emotions
senses.definitionCN: 善于察觉他人情绪
senses.example: A sensitive teacher notices the silent student.
senses.exampleCN: 敏锐的老师会注意到沉默的学生。
senses.why: The leaf also trembles when only the wind changes.
senses.whyCN: 风声刚变，叶已轻颤。

senses.title: Reacting strongly to art or ideas
senses.definition: appreciating art, beauty, or ideas deeply
senses.definitionCN: 深刻领会艺术、美或思想
senses.example: He gives a sensitive reading of the poem.
senses.exampleCN: 他对这首诗的解读极具感受力。
senses.why: The leaf opens fully to the morning light
senses.whyCN: 叶面对晨光全然舒展。

senses.title: Easily harmed; needing careful handling
senses.definition: likely to cause trouble and so needing care
senses.definitionCN: 容易引发问题、须小心对待
senses.example: Do not discuss the sensitive topic at dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚餐时别谈那个敏感话题。
senses.why: Some leaves fold shut if you simply walk past too fast.
senses.whyCN: 有些叶子，你走得太快它就闭合。

senses.title: Instruments that detect small changes
senses.definition: able to measure very small changes
senses.definitionCN: 能测量极微小变化的
senses.example: The sensitive scale weighs a single grain.
senses.exampleCN: 这台灵敏的天平能称出一粒米的重量。
senses.why: The leaf records even the weight of falling dust.
senses.whyCN: 连落尘的重量都记录在叶片上。

intro.en: From Medieval Latin sensitivus, built on Latin sentire (to feel).

items.en: The direction-feeling root *sent- underlies the whole family.

items.en: Sentire means to feel; its forms give sense and feeling words.
items.cn: sentire 意为感受，其形式衍生出 sense 与感受类词汇。

items.en: Scholars formed sensitivus for the perceiving part of the soul.
items.cn: 学者造出 sensitivus 指灵魂中负责感知的部分。

items.en: Old French sensitif passed into English philosophy.
items.cn: 古法语 sensitif 进入英语哲学语汇。

items.en: English adopted sensitive, at first for bodily feeling, later for moods and topics.
items.cn: 英语借入 sensitive，先指身体感觉，后扩及情绪与话题。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sensi- family, and near rivals in the reacting field.
note.cn: sensi- 词族的形近词，以及「反应」义场的近义词。

definition_zh: 分开的；单独的；使分离；区分
definition_en: not joined or touching; to set or keep things apart
core_image: 一把剪刀沿着虚线把纸剪成两半
scene: 办完手续，工作人员把文件分成两沓。The office keeps its files separate from the lab records.

separate 加 -ly 副词后缀，义为「分别地；单独地」
separate 加 -or，义为「分隔符；分离器」

senses.title: Not joined; existing apart
senses.definition: placed or kept apart from other things
senses.definitionCN: 与其他事物分开放置或各自存在
senses.example: The twins sleep in separate rooms now.
senses.exampleCN: 双胞胎现在分房睡了。
senses.why: Two halves of paper now lie on different desks.
senses.whyCN: 半张纸的两半如今躺在两张不同的桌上。

senses.title: Different and not connected
senses.definition: clearly different and independent
senses.definitionCN: 明显不同且彼此独立
senses.example: That is a separate issue from pay.
senses.exampleCN: 那是与薪酬无关的另一件事。
senses.why: Each half carries its own line of writing.
senses.whyCN: 每一半都写着自己的那行字。

senses.title: To set apart things joined before
senses.definition: to divide or keep things that were together
senses.definitionCN: 把原本在一起的东西分开
senses.example: The fence separates the yard from the street.
senses.exampleCN: 栅栏把院子与街道隔开。
senses.why: The scissors move along the dotted line.
senses.whyCN: 剪刀沿虚线推进。

senses.title: To divide into parts
senses.definition: to break a whole into smaller groups
senses.definitionCN: 把整体分成更小的组
senses.example: The class separates into four teams.
senses.exampleCN: 全班分成四个小组。
senses.why: One sheet becomes many small cards.
senses.whyCN: 一张纸变成许多小卡片。

senses.title: To leave a spouse
senses.definition: to stop living together as a couple
senses.definitionCN: 夫妻停止共同生活
senses.example: They separated last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 他们去年春天分居了。
senses.why: The dotted line runs right through the middle of the shared home.
senses.whyCN: 虚线正好从共同的家中间划过。

intro.en: From Latin separare, built on se- (apart) and parare (to prepare, arrange).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 separare，由 se-（分开）与 parare（准备、安排）构成。

items.en: The root *pere- means to bring through or produce, the source of parare.
items.cn: 词根 *pere- 意为「促成、产出」，是 parare 的来源。

items.en: Separare means to set apart, arranging things on different sides.
items.cn: 拉丁语 separare 意为「使分开」，把事物安排到两侧。

items.en: Separatus, the past participle, became the adjective source.
items.cn: 过去分词 separatus 成为形容词的来源。

items.en: Old French separer carried the verb into medieval use.
items.cn: 古法语 separer 把动词带入中世纪用法。

items.en: English took separate in the 1400s for both adjective and verb.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入 separate，兼作形容词与动词。

note.en: Look-alikes in the se- prefix family, and near rivals in the dividing field.
note.cn: se- 前缀词族的形近词，以及「切分」义场的近义词。

abstract.cn: 看见剪刀沿虚线缓缓推进

abstract.en: Picture two halves of one photo on two shelves
abstract.cn: 想象同一张照片的两半摆上两个书架

abstract.en: Feel the quiet gap where one wall used to join

examples.cn: 请把可回收垃圾与厨余分开。

examples.en: The two reports are separate studies.
examples.cn: 这两份报告是独立的研究。

examples.en: The river separates the old town from the new district.
examples.cn: 这条河把老城与新区隔开。

sensesIntro.en: One dotted line, five cuts: rooms apart, issues apart, fences, small cards, and the middle of a shared home.

branches.en: the two halves resting apart
branches.cn: 分置两处的两半

branches.en: each half carrying its own meaning
branches.cn: 每一半各表其义

branches.en: the fence that keeps two sides apart
branches.cn: 让两侧各自安好的栅栏

branches.en: one sheet becoming many cards

definition_zh: 顺序；序列；连续；一段情节
definition_en: a set of things arranged one after another in an order
core_image: 多米诺骨牌按次序排开，第一张推倒后依次倒下
scene: 剪辑室里，导演把镜头片段逐一排开。The film opens with a long chase sequence along the canal.
sceneCN: 这里 sequence 是「连续段落」（第 4 个义项：影片中连贯的片段）；句意是影片以一段沿运河的长追逐戏开场。

derivatives.zh: sequence 的动名词形式，义为「排序；测序」
con 加 sequence 同根词，义为「后果；结果」

senses.title: Things arranged in an order
senses.definition: the order in which things follow one another
senses.definitionCN: 事物彼此相随的次序
senses.example: Keep the cards in sequence from low to high.
senses.exampleCN: 把牌从小到大按顺序排好。
senses.why: The dominoes stand in one straight row.
senses.whyCN: 多米诺骨牌排成笔直的一列。

senses.title: A set of numbers or symbols in order
senses.definition: a list of numbers or signs following a rule
senses.definitionCN: 按规律排列的数字或符号序列
senses.example: The sequence goes two, four, six, eight.
senses.exampleCN: 这个数列是二、四、六、八。
senses.why: Each domino carries the next number in the pattern.
senses.whyCN: 每张牌上都带着规律中的下一个数字。

senses.title: One event after another
senses.definition: a series of connected events or actions
senses.definitionCN: 一连串相关的事件或行动
senses.example: A strange sequence of delays ruined the trip.
senses.exampleCN: 一连串莫名其妙的延误毁了旅行。
senses.why: One domino falls and pulls the whole row after it.
senses.whyCN: 一张倒下，整排随之而倒。

senses.title: A connected part of a film or story
senses.definition: a set of scenes that form one connected part
senses.definitionCN: 构成一个连贯部分的若干场景
senses.example: The dream sequence confused some viewers.
senses.exampleCN: 梦境段落让部分观众感到迷惑。
senses.why: The row of dominoes becomes a row of scenes on screen.
senses.whyCN: 排成一列的骨牌变成了银幕上的一排场景。

senses.title: To determine the order of DNA parts
senses.definition: to find the order of chemical parts in DNA
senses.definitionCN: 测定 DNA 中化学单元的排列顺序
senses.example: The lab sequenced the whole genome.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室完成了全基因组测序。
senses.why: The dominoes are read one by one, each face a letter of life.
senses.whyCN: 骨牌被逐张读取，每一面都是生命的一个字母。

intro.en: From Latin sequentia, a following, from sequi (to follow).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 sequentia「跟随」，源于 sequi（跟随）。

items.en: The root *sekw- means to follow, also seen in sequel.
items.cn: 词根 *sekw- 意为「跟随」，也见于 sequel（续篇）。

items.en: Sequi means to follow; sequentia is the state of following after.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sequi 意为跟随；sequentia 表示随后相随的状态。

items.en: Medieval scholars used sequentia for what follows in a text or rite.
items.cn: 中世纪学者用 sequentia 指文本或仪式中的后续部分。

items.en: Old French sequence carried both order and liturgical senses.
items.cn: 古法语 sequence 兼有次序与礼仪义。

items.en: English adopted it in the 1300s; modern use added math, film, and genes.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入；现代用法又扩及数学、电影与基因。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sequ- family, and near rivals in the order field.
note.cn: sequ- 词族的形近词，以及「次序」义场的近义词。

次序——泛指排列状态，sequence 强调逐项相随
系列——强调成组连续，sequence 强调先后规律
连续；继承——强调时间上的依次承接

normal.en: DNA sequence reads life one letter at a time
normal.cn: DNA 序列逐字读取生命

abstract.en: See letters of life laid out in a glowing line
abstract.cn: 看见生命的字母排成一条发光的线

abstract.en: Feel the chase scenes running one into another
abstract.cn: 体会追逐戏一场接一场地奔涌

examples.en: Follow the steps in the correct sequence.
examples.cn: 按正确的顺序执行这些步骤。

examples.en: The paper studies a special number sequence.
examples.cn: 这篇论文研究了一个特殊的数列。

examples.en: Editors re-cut the fight sequence last night.
examples.cn: 剪辑师昨晚重新剪辑了打斗段落。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「细缝死」——顺序像细缝一样严丝合缝，一步错缝，整列骨牌就死。

root: 拉丁语 sequi「跟随」的名词 sequentia「随后相随」，印欧词根 *sekw-（跟随，同根词 sequel、consequence、suitor）；经古法语进入英语。数列、事件链、影片段落与基因测序诸义均由「一个跟着一个」生长。

sensesIntro.en: One falling domino, five rows: playing cards, number patterns, delayed trains, film scenes, and the letters of life.
sensesIntro.cn: 一张倒下的骨牌，五列牌阵：纸牌、数字规律、晚点的列车、电影场景与生命的字母。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dominoes standing in a row, falling in order
core.cn: 核心意象：多米诺骨牌排成一列，依次倒下

branches.en: the straight row kept in order

branches.en: numbers following a hidden rule

branches.en: events falling one after another

branches.en: the row replayed on the screen

definition_zh: 系列；连续；丛书；（广播或电视）系列节目
definition_en: a number of similar things coming one after another
core_image: 书架上一排同款书籍，书脊整齐地排成一行
scene: 图书馆新到一批科普读物，馆员逐本上架。She bought the third volume of the popular science series.

senses.title: Several similar things following one another
senses.definition: many similar events or objects in succession
senses.definitionCN: 相继出现的多个同类事件或物品
senses.example: A series of accidents forced the road to close.
senses.exampleCN: 一连串事故迫使道路关闭。
senses.why: One shelf, one look: the books stand like one word repeated.
senses.whyCN: 一个书架，一个模样：那些书像同一个词的反复出现。

senses.title: A set of broadcasts or episodes
senses.definition: a show released in connected parts
senses.definitionCN: 分集播出的节目
senses.example: The new comedy series starts in May.
senses.exampleCN: 这部新喜剧五月开播。
senses.why: The same look returns every week on screen.
senses.whyCN: 同样的模样每周在屏幕上回归。

senses.title: A set of books published as one group
senses.definition: books issued one by one under one title plan
senses.definitionCN: 按同一规划陆续出版的成套书籍
senses.example: This series explains science for children.
senses.exampleCN: 这套丛书为孩子讲解科学。
senses.why: Each volume repeats the same spine until the set is full.
senses.whyCN: 每一卷都重复着同样的书脊，直到成套。

senses.title: Sports matches played in succession
senses.definition: a group of games between the same teams
senses.definitionCN: 同两队之间连续进行的比赛
senses.example: The teams split the series two all.
senses.exampleCN: 两队以二比二平分系列赛。
senses.why: The shelf becomes a row of match days.
senses.whyCN: 书架变成了一排比赛日。

senses.title: In electrical circuits, one after another
senses.definition: connected so current passes through each part in turn
senses.definitionCN: 电流依次流过各部件的连接方式
senses.example: The bulbs are wired in series.
senses.exampleCN: 这些灯泡是串联的。
senses.why: The row of books becomes a row of bulbs sharing one wire.
senses.whyCN: 书排变成了共用电线的一排灯泡。

intro.en: From Latin series, a row or chain, from serere (to join, link).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 series「一列、一串」，源于 serere（连接、串起）。

items.en: A root *ser- means to line up or join, seen in assert.
items.cn: 词根 *ser- 意为「排成一行、连接」，也见于 assert。

items.en: Serere means to bind together; series is the joined row.
items.cn: 拉丁语 serere 意为「串起」；series 就是串成的一列。

items.en: Roman writers used series for chains of causes and rows of books.
items.cn: 罗马作家用 series 指因果链与书列。

items.en: Later scholars kept series for ordered sets in math and logic.
items.cn: 后世学者在数学与逻辑中沿用 series 表示有序集合。

items.en: English adopted series around 1600; broadcasting uses grew in the 1900s.
items.cn: 英语约在 1600 年借入 series；二十世纪又发展出广播义。

note.en: Look-alikes in the seri- family, and near rivals in the succession field.
note.cn: seri- 词族的形近词，以及「接连」义场的近义词。

normal.cn: serere 意为连接：series 就是一串连成行的东西

normal.en: a TV series airs one part every week
normal.cn: TV series 每周播出一集

normal.en: in series means current follows one path

normal.en: serialization turns a story into weekly parts
normal.cn: serialization 把故事拆成每周连载

abstract.en: Picture identical book spines marching along a shelf
abstract.cn: 想象同款书脊沿书架整齐列队

abstract.en: See a match day pinned up after match day
abstract.cn: 看见比赛日一张接一张钉上墙

abstract.en: Feel one wire quietly linking every bulb
abstract.cn: 体会一根电线静静串起每只灯泡

examples.en: The two lamps are connected in series.
examples.cn: 这两盏灯是串联的。

root: 拉丁语 serere「连接、串起」的名词 series「串成的一列」，印欧词根 *ser-（排成一行，同根词 assert、insert）；十七世纪进入英语。丛书、连续剧、系列赛与电学串联诸义都从「串成一行」生长。
